name: Hypericum perforatum extract
description: Hypericum perforatum extract (CAS 84082-80-4 ), derived from St. John's Wort, is a botanical extract standardized for active marker compounds including hypericin and hyperforin. It is a commercially established ingredient sourced by formulators across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and personal care sectors. The extract is highly valued for its antioxidant activity and skin-conditioning properties. In dietary supplement manufacturing, it is used as the active botanical in capsule, tablet, and softgel formats, with standardized hypericin content serving as the key quality benchmark. Personal care formulators incorporate it into topical creams, serums, and balms where antioxidant protection and skin-soothing performance are required. In functional food and nutraceutical beverage applications, it appears in herbal teas, tinctures, and liquid supplement formats. Cosmetic manufacturers also use it in after-sun and sensitive-skin product lines where botanical antioxidant claims support positioning. Hypericum perforatum extract is supplied as a dry powder, liquid extract, or oil-based preparation depending on the intended application. Standard commercial grades are defined by hypericin content, typically ranging from 0.3% to 0.5%, with some suppliers offering hyperforin-standardized variants. Grades conforming to Ph. Eur. monograph specifications are available for pharmaceutical procurement. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade options serve broader formulation needs across various industries. This versatile botanical remains a staple for manufacturers seeking reliable, standardized plant extracts for high-performance product development and consumer-facing health applications.
